candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the stored balance so the recorded balance after Put is unchanged.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment so the stored balance equals only msg.value instead of accumulating.
Replace the clamped unlockTime computation with a direct assignment so a past _unlockTime can be stored, changing Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime after Put.
Replace the unlockTime computation with the current timestamp so any caller-supplied future unlock time is ignored, changing the stored unlockTime after Put.
Delete the statement that decreases the holder's balance after a successful withdrawal, so the recorded balance never decreases on Collect.
Remove the `acc.balance>=MinSum` requirement from the withdrawal guard so withdrawals are allowed even when the balance is below MinSum.
Remove the `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` time-lock requirement so funds can be collected before the unlock time.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log's History.
Change the amount sent to the caller from `_am` to the full remaining balance `acc.balance`, transferring more (and deducting more) than requested.
Change the balance check from `acc.balance>=_am` to `acc.balance>_am`, so withdrawing the exact full balance now reverts instead of succeeding.
Set unlockTime directly to _unlockTime without the max against block.timestamp.
Set unlockTime to the current block.timestamp regardless of _unlockTime.
Swap the branches of the ternary so the smaller of _unlockTime and block.timestamp is used.
Delete the assignment to acc.unlockTime so the stored unlock time is never updated.
Delete the statement that decreases the account balance after a successful withdrawal.
Replace the balance subtraction with an addition, so withdrawing increases the stored balance.
Delete the unlockTime check so funds can be withdrawn before the lock expires.
Replace `revert ()` with an empty statement block so a failed transfer is silently ignored instead of reverting.
